title: Bhikkhū (or Suddaka)
text: 2. Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparayāno || katamehi catuhi || || 3. Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || || Dhamme || Saṅghe || || Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 4. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
